decisions.reason: Changing the AXP2101 thermal-pad stencil aperture does not alter the VBACKUP breakout, purpose, location, or population requirement.
The stencil change does not modify the required current capacity, copper continuity, bottleneck prohibition, or via stitching; the VBUS observation is diagnostic only.
The source decision concerns the thermal-pad paste aperture and does not change PWROK breakout access or its debugging purpose.
The AXP2101 center-pad stencil pattern is independent of the required placement of AXP2101 and MT3608 decoupling capacitors.
The AXP2101 stencil modification does not affect the ESP32 decoupling values or accepted capacitor placement.
The source retains the AXP2101 and changes only its stencil aperture; it does not alter the power architecture, required rails, charging behavior, or efficiency goal.
The manufacturing stencil change does not modify battery overcharge, overdischarge, or NTC thermal-protection requirements.
The AXP2101 thermal-pad stencil pattern does not change the MT3608 switched 5V rail, its GPIO control, loads, or operating pattern.
The stencil update does not resolve or change the separate VRTC connection requirement.
The thermal-pad manufacturing change does not alter the panel button connector, PWRON connection, location, or switching behavior.
The AXP2101 stencil decision does not affect the battery connector family, pin count, functions, compatibility, or unresolved pin order.
The source uses abnormal DCDC1 behavior as evidence for a soldering issue but does not change the required DCDC1 voltage, current rating, role, or compensation target.
